entries.principle: Right to privacy and data protection
entries.principle_source: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (2021) §§32–34 https://www.unesco.org/en/legal-affairs/recommendation-ethics-artificial-intelligence
entries.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan On Personal Data and Their Protection, 21 May 2013, No. 94-V
entries.provision: Article 7(1), consent to processing, subject to the stated exceptions. https://old.adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/Z1300000094/compare/eng
entries.why_here: The bare pipeline called the model for all 6 test requests. Refusal checks enforce scope, consent and safe form data before inference.
